blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, Philippines — Two motorcycle drivers were killed, and two others were injured in a three-vehicle collision along the Makar-Seguel Road in Barangay Calumpang, General Santos City, early Sunday, Oct. 25, police said. The accident occurred at about 6:17 a.m. near an Iglesia ni Cristo church, involving three motorcycles traveling in opposite directions, according to a police spot report. Initial investigation conducted by the GenSan Traffic Enforcement Unit showed that a Suzuki Raider motorcycle driven by Rauf Nashrudin Dicolano, 27, and a TMX motorcycle driven by Tammy Yanngon, 34, were traveling from Tambler toward Makar.
